summary: Seven strong-value active used‑SUV listings (2020+ and under ~40 k miles) identified in Philadelphia metro and nearby NJ/PA. Standouts include a CPO 2026 Subaru Forester Premium AWD under $32.5 k, and similarly priced 2026 Forester Premium AWD with very low miles. Several new 2026 CR‑V EX‑L AWD appear but lack full details. All vehicles show strong reliability; hybrids not prioritized unless compelling.

Auto Navigator shows several 2026 Forester Premium AWD CPO at Reedman Toll and Rafferty with very low miles (e.g., 2,968 mi for $31,499 at Reedman Toll).
Cars.com regional listing shows new 2026 Honda CR‑V EX‑L AWD in region but details incomplete—availability active but price/mileage not accessible.

trimComparisons.model: Subaru Forester Premium AWD vs Cr‑V EX‑L AWD
trimComparisons.comparison: Forester Premium AWD CPO offers Subaru’s EyeSight safety suite, typically similar adaptive cruise and visibility benefits, while CR‑V EX‑L adds more comfort features like leather, heated seats, moonroof. Pricing for Forester starts lower (~31k) vs typical ~$37k for CR‑V. Fuel economy similar (Forester ~26 city / 33 highway, CR‑V ~27/31).
